recommendations.title: Review CPU request for synthetic/api
recommendations.summary: The upstream CPU request candidate is not below the accelerator safety floor and passed the required evidence gates; validate it through a separately approved canary.
prerequisites: Confirm the metric window contains peak and business-critical periods.
Review P99 usage, throttling, startup and failover behavior.
risks: Historical usage might not represent future peaks.
Lower requests can change placement and noisy-neighbor behavior.
validation_steps: Run VPA in Off mode and compare recommendations.
Canary an independently approved request change and verify SLOs under load.
proposed_actions: Review the validated upstream request candidate and rollback criteria before any customer-owned PR.
rollback_steps: Restore the previous CPU request of 1000.0 mCPU in source configuration through the owning delivery pipeline.
Stop promotion if SLOs, throttling, OOM or restarts regress; remeasure before proposing another change.

limitations: synthetic recommendation

recommendations.title: Review capacity management and NAP prerequisites
recommendations.summary: Current capacity configuration and declared intent support investigation only, not NAP eligibility, migration approval, lower minima, removable nodes or financial savings.

evidence.unit: observed nodes; not complete supply or removable nodes

evidence.value: unknown: network, identity, quota/SKU, workload/disruption fit, operational acceptance

prerequisites: Review current Microsoft AKS NAP support for the exact version, region, networking and identity.
Preserve system capacity, Spot interruption tolerance, hardware, zoning and owner-reserved capacity.
Compare CAS tuning with a separately approved transition; do not enable NAP or disable CAS from this report.
risks: Removing minima or migrating capacity can violate disruption, storage, specialized hardware and failover requirements.
NAP has unsupported configurations and stop/start and egress constraints; configuration eligibility alone is insufficient.
validation_steps: Confirm complete NAP API lists, exact owner/provider identities, node-class requirements, limits and disruption budgets.
Validate all unknown prerequisites using separately approved sanitized evidence and current AKS documentation.
Require workload-fit, pending-Pod, availability and packing evidence before a separate migration proposal.
proposed_actions: Investigate capacity classes and missing prerequisites; guarded mode does not authorize migration.
rollback_steps: No change is proposed. A later approved experiment must retain original capacity and define an owner-controlled rollback.

recommendations.title: Review current optimization constraints
recommendations.summary: Current probe, topology or voluntary-disruption evidence may constrain scaling, disruption, consolidation or portability. Guarded mode does not authorize a change or generate configuration.
prerequisites: Ask the workload owner which startup, health, availability, failure-domain and disruption behavior the application requires.
Verify actual PDB selectors and eligible Pods with approved Kubernetes tooling before relating a budget to a workload.
risks: Adding probes without application semantics can cause restart loops or remove healthy endpoints from service.
Changing topology or disruption policy can reduce availability, violate storage constraints or increase correlated failure risk.
validation_steps: Validate probe behavior during startup, steady state, dependency failure and graceful termination using owner-approved tests.
Validate replica placement and failure-domain behavior before any topology-policy experiment.
Recheck actual PDB selectors, desired healthy counts and disruptions allowed immediately before any separately approved voluntary disruption.
proposed_actions: Review the observed constraints with the workload and platform owners; guarded mode does not authorize or generate a change.
rollback_steps: No configuration is generated or applied. Restore any separately approved probe, topology or PDB experiment through the owner's delivery system if validation regresses.
